reason: The user has provided their email address in response to the mandatory authentication request. The policy explicitly requires authentication at the beginning of the conversation by locating the user ID via email or name+zip code. The find_user_id_by_email tool is the appropriate mechanism to fulfill this mandatory first step. No prohibitions apply to this initial authentication action.
policy_references: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code. This has to be done even when the user already provides the user id.
Once the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information
